data.narrative:
Exodys Energy is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Carl Perez and Jean-Christophe Piroux that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 nuclear energy peers: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Applied Atomics.

A peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow nuclear peer set—only one adjacent-stage comparable was identified against a minimum threshold of three. Accordingly, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 2.5x multiplier to the $10M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $25M.

The triangulated valuation range is $21M to $29M, with a median estimate of $25M. This range reflects a conservative application of Seed-stage expansion multiples typical across frontier technology sectors. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of tight-peer median benchmarking and reliance on a single methodological input. Additional valuation refinement would benefit from either (1) identification of additional private nuclear peers at comparable development stages, or (2) closer examination of public comps' risk profiles relative to Exodys's development trajectory.
